scope: Failure-only exact distinct-net closed-rectangle vertex-cut necessary bound. Every net with an actual M11 terminal inside and outside must use at least one inside boundary vertex; both layers and all their boundary vertices are allowed, so capacity overestimates availability. Whole native pin array and every bus bounding rectangle with 0/1/2/4/8 grid padding sampled. Lack of a sampled violation does not prove routability or timing; no geometry or gate changes.
